aad5778d48adc5162ce7.text: Hello learner! Have you experienced difficulty connecting your ideas and

c25b8a9474e7132199f5.text: coming up with a well-organized message? Have you heard any speech which you find difficult to understand? Well, this module is carefully crafted to help you use and understand cohesive devices in various types of speech.

bfe86cded1d42a219b1c.text: Moreover, this module has different activities that are highly engaging which

1f9dc09c3213496f4613.text: will help you understand the functions and application of these cohesive devices. Hopefully, this will guide you through your writing. This will also help you write cohesively.

65146c5be6bb694d6e52.text: The Most Essential Learning Competency (MELC) covered in this module

902ffb4ab69e0d0d9a76.text: focuses on the use of appropriate cohesive devices in various types of speech.

5f13d3ff76cd44d971b3.text: As a learner of this module, you are expected to:

65001c23efc6c6e98a38.text:  classify the different types of cohesive devices;  use appropriate cohesive devices in a paragraph;  create a speech using appropriate cohesive devices; and  realize the importance of using cohesive devices in a speech.

2796cc359ef9f9e56ab4.text: The test you are about to take is a pre-assessment which will determine how

e72c10c77bf3b3a9989c.text: well you know the module you are about to explore. If you get all the items correctly, you can skip the module. However, if you get one mistake, you have to proceed and complete the activities.

a30e4ce36e3444e91c41.text: In your previous module, you learned about analyzing literature as a mirror

f72b3fd606bb47fd5203.text: of people’s shared heritage. Similarly, maintaining unity in writing shares that characteristic of literature. In making sure meaning is clearly conveyed, we consider writing in the most cohesive way. In this activity, you will be assessed on the extent of your learning from the previous lesson in connection with the current topic.

8b2867afe49fbeec7e82.text: Directions: Read the passage below. Answer the following questions. Write only the letter of your answer on a separate sheet of paper.

2787fcefbd67c2403a81.text: Adapted story from Mabel Cook Cole, Philippine Folk Tales

1484c8d8cf031313b1e6.text: One day, there was a man who had been in the forest to gather his

58a3addc595611c15496.text: coconuts. He loaded his horse heavily with them. On his way home, he met a boy and a girl whom he asked on how long it would take him to reach the house.

f5612a8c4456e7a2787b.text: "If you go slowly," said the boy, looking at the load on the horse, "you will

475be0557f53b5ee3a8e.text: arrive very soon; but if you go fast, it will take you all day."

3466f940cf77b6fe98e4.text: The man could not believe this strange speech, so, he hurried his horse.

7a0ab0ec467b89bdf451.text: However, the coconuts fell off and he had to stop to pick them up. Then, he hurried his horse all the more to make up for lost time; still, the coconuts fell off again. Many times he did this, and it was night when he reached home.

f5ade4cd57a01fe87de1.text: 1. Where did the story take place?

bbb2f0f91e95824af0df.text: 2. How will you describe the character in the story?

e883abc6873b6c566bc9.text: A. Never listen to the advice of others. B. Being close-minded is good for you. C. Accepting help from others is a bad thing. D. If you rush things out, you will never finish your work on time.

0707ab00c7118851ded6.text: 4. In the second paragraph, how is the word “but” used in the sentence?

7d7da9d1d8dbb9c354a3.text: B. to show contrast of ideas

06fcfbc9e58c73d8a2f5.text: 5. Which among the choices express the functions of the above highlighted words?

98c3a759aea350fa404c.text: Like any form of writing, literature also requires cohesiveness. At this point,

74cfabebbbc8f7a821d3.text: it is important to learn how cohesion can best be achieved. Specifically, what devices can writers take advantage to come-up with a well-organized message? Directions: Read the dialog below.

88ddafd466f555fb15b6.text: Yes Ma’am. This is Anna. How are

47e19f7d382187b7716e.text: Hello? Is Anna on the line? I am

3603cf246d5a8614e3bd.text: you Ma’am? I’ve been inside our house,

6d52d5a1f01adf86bdae.text: Mrs. Cruz, her adviser in Grade 8.

d11767efb8462716143e.text: since the day the government declared that it is not safe to go out. I miss going to

db0c8e9490d25f64b82e.text: discussions, and I also miss talking with my classmates. However, my parents tell me to stay home because they are concerned of my safety.

8026d802fa83d9c91eca.text: Despite the situation we are in

d4c54e8934e07279ae1b.text: Anna, I’m happy to hear all these things from you. You really love going to school. Even I, myself, miss school and my students so much. Although we are facing

e50270715f02efe8cb8c.text: a pandemic right now, the Department of

c966bfa31ce12b7b06cb.text: Education still puts an effort towards

8ff2a9ad2cfdc65d81c7.text: helping you continue schooling. So, the

42dce355da1076a6460f.text: parents will be pleased to know

8b5b98b6186f832693d1.text: these. Since we have internet at

e071fd98b3b46aaaca7a.text: home, I think I can do online.

fac5f24064bfb2cec3b8.text: Thank you so much for reaching

54f814e96dfdfe3c6760.text: out to me Ma’am. Stay safe and

9b684175d94f48e633da.text: not worry, for the department considers

8879abf8386b6c3a7497.text: You are welcome Anna. Send my regards to your parents. Stay healthy and enjoy learning.

d0c0d4de8fa6c2a50124.text:  What is the dialog all about?  What is the concern of Anna’s parents in enrolling her to class this school year?  How did Mrs. Cruz convince Anna and her parents to attend school?

b55a5082a12c1f7645b2.text: Now that we know what they talked about, let us look closely the cohesive devices used in this conversation.

ada0e0083a88b887640b.text:  In the first response of Anna, how did she explain to her teacher about her whereabouts during the present situation?

1dee50ade10ab018111a.text: She told her teacher that she was in her house since the day that the

4c7de6cd6be2799d377e.text: government declared that it is not safe to go out.

ef624d7accfef0595793.text: The use of “since” expresses time describing when she started to stay

f6fd4b49a532cb7176aa.text: inside their house. It can also express cause or reason like in the statement, "Since we have internet at home, I think I can do online.”

595066201d84192b9523.text:  In the response of Mrs. Cruz regarding Ana attending school, how is the word “although”used?

780ae0b8ea3cb37e31c7.text: Although in the sentence expresses reason and provide an option to

e75d7d766dbcddd99829.text: answer the problem mentioned in the situation.

f46b8945de417ed0d414.text:  Try deleting the words despite and although, what do you think will happen to the statements above?

474936d134f72649e230.text: Without those words, the statement seems choppy and disconnected.

389c92d6eb4fa702c330.text: The ideas presented look as if they are not unified.

2d6a55e5834199d22a94.text:  Why is it important that our ideas are interconnected?

f107f9481df295a33a75.text: It is important for us to be understood by the readers as well as for

c0982186ac351f3d0f7a.text:  How can we ensure that our ideas are linked together? What devices should we use?

5e54476a325196ba07cc.text: We can ensure that our ideas are linked together if we know the

a27daf7a3ad87d93e58d.text: functions and purposes of the different cohesive devices.

9b3bd75511fe056911ad.text: Now that you learned about how to make ideas flow through cohesive devices,

33c5a68ad153eefaefd1.text: let us learn more about other strategies to achieve cohesion. Well, this part of the module will teach you different connectors called cohesive devices which you can use in writing.

b12d39958795722f7153.text: Study the sentences below. These are some responses which are taken from

f121fe2087d6ffd0e4cb.text: the previous dialogue. 1. Stay healthy and enjoy learning

2a63785d4f65b4197640.text: to stay home and stop schooling because they are concerned of my safety.

fe067a813adf7cb58978.text: 2. Therefore, we do not have to worry anymore.

c65568af79ffb3cfba5f.text: As you can see in the given sentences, you will notice that there are word

1f482a1f1b9defadab94.text: connectors used to link your ideas to make your sentence clear and easy to understand.

89dc31cb17097037227d.text: 1. Stay healthy and enjoy learning with us.

20a7a2ef6767801917e3.text: In the first sentence, the word “and” is used to add something to the previous

981d1252e1f83a36d7dc.text: idea. It connects the ideas of “Stay healthy” and “enjoy learning with us.” Also, you will notice that both statements start with verbs “stay” and “enjoy”. Thus, apart from using the word connector “and”, using parallel structures as seen in the example may be used to achieve cohesion.

fbc588528c57a6368600.text: 2. Therefore, we do not have to worry anymore.

4cfbf3c2a3bce9ba176f.text: In the second sentence, the word “therefore” is used to give or show

a263e8c2e11481587a7c.text: conclusion. With the efforts of the Department of Education with regards to students attending classes, Anna and her parents therefore, do not have to worry about her enrolment. Also, you will notice the use of the pronoun “we” which apparently refers back to Anna’s parents. The use of pronoun is also another cohesive device that you can take advantage. When you keep on referring to the same idea, it makes ideas stick together.

ae8162836d84b6cf733f.text: 3. However, my parents told me to stay home and stop schooling because they are concerned of my safety.

ad01005719ba896284bf.text: In the third sentence, the word “but” shows contrast of ideas. Also, the word

81f9d08acd163f37f3e9.text: “because” shows reason. So, in the sentence, because Anna’s parents are concerned of her safety.

a3e0c7e5162e993f6c73.text: Apart from using these connectors, it was also evident that there were a couple

bf83b7c943687a09cb0f.text: of repetitions evident in the dialogue. What words were repeated? The words school and stay were repeated. Also, the idea of the pandemic which was suggested by the following phrases the situation right now and pandemic are repeated. Thus, another way of achieving cohesion is through repetition of ideas or words.

19bd5182331c191a0411.text: This time, let us discuss more about cohesive devices.

1785c25d94803e434052.text: Cohesion in writing may be achieved through the following means: 1. Repetition of words or ideas. This helps to focus your ideas and to

275d3f17d45248c099f4.text: keep your reader on track. Example:

430c0f0c590765bd7ed2.text: Most people find contemporary art difficult to understand.

fe514531951406561cd4.text: Contemporary art is purposely abstract, leaving the viewers wondering what they are looking at.

9d2872c5259440ad7acb.text: 2. Use of synonyms for key words and phrases. Synonyms are words that have essentially the same meaning, and they provide some variety of word choices, helping the reader to stay focused on the idea being discussed. Example:

0c5c8075a2092c4feb5b.text: At the end of the run, he was suddenly afraid. The height of

40a0c17ad01c323d8203.text: 3. Pronouns / Determiners. This, that, these, those, he, she, it, they, and we are useful pronouns for referring to something previously mentioned. Be sure, however, that what you are referring to is clear. Example:

f9f5c475309734b7f030.text: Mr. Noviel Fraga is the CEO of Fraga Fisheries and Company.

7cd8330a25d003b0ff9b.text: 4. Use transitional devices (linkers, conjunctions or connectors). These are words which give cues to the readers on the relationships between sentences, joining sentences together.

f8758a4b9eec263ff601.text: The most common cohesive device used is the use of transitional devices. They

7c5f561cfc695cf318d1.text: are sometimes called linking words, linkers, connectors, or transitional words. These are words or group of words that show the relationship between sentences and paragraphs of a text or speech. These are words like ‘For example’, ‘In conclusion’, ‘however’, and ‘moreover’.

35bd42a9d66048f0b0fd.text: We use them to link sentences, paragraphs or any pieces of texts. In other

328631b23614debfbe7d.text: words, cohesive devices make our ideas coherent, consistent and organized. Inappropriate use of these can affect the flow of thoughts or ideas expressed in the sentence.

6d4bb92ce9e16444e18b.text: The common transition words are shown below.

421f6df73988c23ba0bf.text: Cohesive Devices     Type: Cohesive Devices Description Examples  Conjunctions 1. Coordinating Conjunctions These conjunctions connect words, phrases, and clauses of equal value. Clauses or equal value are called independent clauses and can stand on their own as separate sentence. for for explaining why He gains more weight, for he eats too much sweets.   and the same, similar or equal; without contrast His favorite snacks are apples and bananas.   nor for two non- contrasting grammatically, negative items He doesn’t like soft drinks, nor hard liquors.   but for contrast I eat vegetables, but I never eat junk foods.   or an alternative Would you like bread or cookies with your coffee?   yet contrast, despite, something He is still young, yet he is already very responsible.   so for showing the consequence of something He was very hungry, so he ate the remaining fruits.   because, so that, as, since to express cause or reason As he was feeling sick, Pedro didn’t go to work yesterday.

and

nor
for two non- contrasting grammatically, negative items

but
for contrast

or
an alternative

contrast, despite, something

2. Subordinating Conjunctions The clause beginning with the subordinating conjunction is always the subordinate clause, which depends on the main clause and cannot exist without it.
before, after, until/till, when, as soon as, whenever, while
to express time
The baby cries whenever he feels hungry.
unless, if, even if, in case, providing
to express condition
I’ll lend you my phone, provided that you will use it carefully.
although, even though, whereas
to express contrast or concession
Joy loves outdoor activities, whereas her sister prefers to stay home.

3. Adverbial Conjunctions These are words that join independent clauses into one sentence. A conjunctive adverb helps you create a shorter sentence. When you use a conjunctive adverb, put a semicolon (;) before it and a comma (,) after it.
also, besides, finally, furthermore, in addition, moreover, still,
adding something
It rained hard; moreover, lightning flashed and thunder boomed.
also, as well, alike, similarly
comparing
Sleeping early makes me feel relax; also, makes me active for the next day.
at the same time, in contrast, in spite of, on the other hand even if
contrasting
I wanted to finish answering my activity in this module; even if, it takes longer time to do it.
certainly, definitely, indeed, in fact
emphasizing
Following health protocols is; indeed, very important for us to be safe.

How to Wash Your Hands Properly According to the World Health Organization (WHO), you need to wash your hands properly so that you can protect yourself against infection. Wash your hands with soap and water, then, dry them thoroughly. If not, use alcohol-based hand rub.

1cd7b99bfc3c42c1c6dc.text: Washing your hands properly should be as long as singing the "Happy Birthday" song twice. Here are the steps: first, you need to wet hands with water; second, apply enough soap to cover up all hand surfaces; third, rub hands palm to palm; fourth, palm to palm with fingers interlaced; fifth, back to fingers to opposing palms with fingers interlocked; sixth, rotational rubbing of left hand; seventh, rotational rubbing of backwards and forwards with clasped fingers of right hand and left hand and vice versa; then, rinse hands with water; and finally, dry thoroughly with a single use of towel.                     Why do we need to wash our hands properly? If you answered, “we need to wash our hands for us to be clean and to avoid acquiring the virus”, then, you got it right.  How are the highlighted words used in the passage? The highlighted words are called cohesive devices. They are used to show the proper sequence or steps on how to wash your hands properly.  In writing a demonstrative speech, the cohesive devices to be used show steps or manner of how things should be done. Persuasive – this text is used to convince the readers or listeners to change          the way they think, do, so they begin doing something new. Below is an example:          Example:          Why go out when it is much safer at home? Why don’t you reflect and ponder on lessons brought about by this pandemic rather than blame others? Why do you always have to rant or complain on social media about the government’s work when you can be of help to it? My dear friends, this pandemic will never be gone if, we, the people, will not help our government officials and front liners prevent it. The only way we can be of help to them is to follow the implemented policies and health protocols.
